question: What claim about transmission is at stake in stating that the teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover?
premises: A teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters is in view.
The transmitter is described as an earth-mover.
inference: The teaching on the earth-moving good-eaters is presented as transmitted by an earth-moving agent.
uncertainties: The relation between the two groups named remains unclear from this verse alone.
plain_english: The teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters was told by the earth-mover, O beloved.
